affiliation: GAeN group · Catalan Institute of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (ICN2)
intro: At ICN2 I write the software that helps a microscope find and analyse nanoparticles: the models that recognise them and the automation that drives the search.

areas.title: Microscope automation
areas.text: Designed and implemented the motion system the microscope uses to search a sample for nanoparticles, as part of a Python project to automate their identification.

areas.title: Image processing
areas.text: Developed a method to generate noisy images and assemble them into a mosaic.

areas.title: Machine learning & computer vision
areas.text: Building AI-driven models for nanoparticle analysis. My master's Major and Minor projects both applied machine learning to microscopy.

areas.title: Data analysis
areas.text: Statistics and data analysis training from the Master of Multidisciplinary Research in Experimental Sciences (BIST–UPF).

publications.title: Mic-hackathon 2024: hackathon on machine learning for electron and scanning probe microscopy.
